protocol.statistics: Pearson chi-square without Yates correction, SciPy survival probability; symmetric label-blind pooled categories with expected cells >=5, degenerate tests p=1/uninformative. Holm correction over all 140 reserved tests. Post-end positions use absorbing STOP (-1), never condition on surviving to that position.
protocol.arithmetic: 4 contexts * (24 positions + 10 adjacent pairs + 1 length) * 1 new candidate = 140 tests.

output_feature_encoding.valid_token_ids: Every integer token ID >= 0, including token 0, remains an observed token.
output_feature_encoding.early_stop_rule: Every position after sequence termination is STOP; do not condition on surviving to a position.
output_feature_encoding.empty_output_rule: A zero-length output has length 0 and STOP at every tested position.

protocol.nomination_rule: Freeze this single source and artifact bundle before its first new candidate output. Preserve both reserved chunks, all contexts and failed outcomes. Do not substitute a source, shrink the sample or repeat to pass.
protocol.scope: A distinct finite regression screen for the new nominated source against the reused recovered control.

nomination.baseline_reuse: This original control also appears in the historical 280-test supplemental screen. Candidate observations use a new independent seed range and frozen source.
nomination.scope: The two candidate chunks belong to this nominated bundle only. Changed binaries require a new registration and new candidate observations.
